transport: Alexandra Gardens, Alma Road; confirm race-day parking or rail approach.
facilities: Bag drop, chip timing and finish refreshments.

name: Windsor Trail Half Marathon & 10K August

name: Finsbury Park Half Marathon, 10K, 5K & Juniors November
course: Tarmac park paths; half nine laps plus mini loop, 10K four plus mini loop, 5K two.
transport: No designated event parking; public transport recommended to Finsbury Park Athletics Track.
facilities: Bag drop, chip timing and event village.
rules: Minimum ages: half 17, 10K 15, 5K 11. Count the laps carefully on the longer distances.
reason: An accessible North London venue with four distances, but the half repeats nine hilly laps. The lap count and 279m ascent distinguish it from flatter city halves.
